title: Bulk change where every part fails keeps the selection
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ALLFAIL-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ALLFAIL-02) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • {Part-A} and {Part-B} share the start of their numbers (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ALLFAIL-0), so one search lists them together.
  • A second browser tab is open on Parts → Inventory at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab search the shared start (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ALLFAIL-0), turn on "Deactivate parts" and tick both parts.
  2. In the second tab set {Part-A} and {Part-B} inactive (each: open, pick "Inactive", Save, "Deactivate").
  3. In the first tab click "Deactivate" and confirm with "Deactivate".
  4. Read the message and the list, then wait 10 seconds. Do not close the message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: "No parts were changed." lists {Part-A} and {Part-B}, each with "Part is already in that state.", and it stays until closed. The list stays on screen, the bulk mode stays on and both parts are still ticked ("2 selected"), ready to retry.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
